phrases.def: 自然资源自然资源自然资源

sentences.en: For many environmentalists, the world seems to be getting worse.
sentences.zh: 对于许多环保主义者来说,世界似乎正在恶化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: They have developed a hit-list of our main fears: that natural resources are running out; that the population is ever growing, leaving less and less to eat; that species are becoming extinct in vast numbers, and that the planet’s air and water are becoming ever more polluted.
sentences.zh: 他们形成了我们主要恐惧的打击清单:自然资源正在耗尽;人口正在不断增长,越来越少地用于吃饭;物种正在大量灭绝,地球的空气和水正在变得越来越受到污染。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But a quick look at the facts shows a different picture.
sentences.zh: 但快速地看一看事实,就可以看出不同的情况。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: First, energy and other natural resources have become more abundant, not less so, since the book ‘The limits to Growth’ was published in 1972 by a group of scientists.
sentences.zh: 首先,自1972年一群科学家出版《增长的极限》一书以来,能源和其他自然资源已经更加丰富,而不是更少。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Second, more food is now produced per head of the world’s population than at any time in history.
sentences.zh: 第二,现在全世界人均粮食产量比历史上任何时候都要高。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Fewer people are starving.
sentences.zh: 饥饿的人更少。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Third, although species are indeed becoming extinct, only about 0.7% of them are expelled to disappear in the next 50 years, not 25-50%, as has so often been predicted.
sentences.zh: 第三,虽然物种确实正在灭绝,但只有大约0.7%的物种被驱逐,以便在今后50年内消失,而不是像人们经常预测的那样,25%至50%。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: And finally, most forms of environmental pollution either appear to have been exaggerated, or are transient – associated with the early phases of industrialisation and therefore best cured not by restricting economic growth, but by accelerating it.
sentences.zh: 最后,大多数形式的环境污染似乎要么被夸大,要么是短暂的,与工业化的早期阶段有关,因此最好不是通过限制经济增长,而是通过加速经济增长来治愈。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: One form of pollution – the release of greenhouse gases that causes global warming – does appear to be a phenomenon that is going to extend well into our future, but its total impact is unlikely to pose a devastating problem.
sentences.zh: 一种污染形式 — — 释放导致全球变暖的温室气体 — — 似乎是一种将延及我们未来的现象,但其总影响不大可能构成毁灭性问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A bigger problem may well turn out to be an inappropriate response to it.
sentences.zh: 一个更大的问题很可能被证明是对其不适当的反应。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Yet opinion polls suggest that many people nurture the belief that environmental standards are declining and four factors seem to cause this disjunction between perception and reality.
sentences.zh: 然而民意测验显示,许多人认为环境标准正在下降,有四个因素似乎造成观念与现实之间的脱节。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: One is the lopsidedness built into scientific research.
sentences.zh: 一个是科学研究中存在的偏向性。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Scientific funding goes mainly to areas with many problems.
sentences.zh: 科学资金主要用于有许多问题的领域。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: That may be wise policy but it will also create an impression that many more potential problems exist than is the case.
sentences.zh: 这或许是明智的政策,但也会造成一种印象,即存在比情况更多的潜在问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Secondly, environmental groups need to be noticed by the mass media.
sentences.zh: 第二,大众传媒必须注意环境群体。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: They also need to keep the money rolling in.
sentences.zh: 他们也需要保持资金的滚动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Understandably, perhaps, they sometimes overstate their arguments.
sentences.zh: 也许可以理解,他们有时会夸大其论点。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In 1997, for example, the World Wide Fund for Nature issued a press release entitled: ‘Two thirds of the world’s forests lost forever’.
sentences.zh: 例如,1997年,世界自然基金会发表题为 " 全世界森林的三分之二永远丧失 " 的新闻稿。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The truth turns out to be nearer 20%.
sentences.zh: 事实证明,事实已经接近20%了

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Though these groups are run overwhelmingly by selfless folk, they nevertheless share many of the characteristics of other lobby groups.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些群体绝大多数由无私的民间人士管理,但他们与其他游说团体有许多共同的特点。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: That would matter less if people applied the same degree of scepticism to environmental lobbying as they do to lobby groups in other fields.
sentences.zh: 如果人们像对待其他领域的游说团体那样,对环境游说活动持同样的怀疑态度,那么,这一点就不重要了。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A trade organisation arguing for, say, weaker pollution control is instantly seen as self-interested.
sentences.zh: 例如,一个贸易组织主张较弱的污染控制立即被视为符合自身利益。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Yet a green organisation opposing such a weakening is seen as altruistic, even if an impartial view of the controls in question might suggest they are doing more harm than good.
sentences.zh: 然而,反对这种削弱的绿色组织被视为利他主义,即使对相关控制措施的公正看法可能表明它们正在做更多的弊大于利。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: A third source of confusion is the attitude of the media.
sentences.zh: 媒体的态度是造成混淆的第三个原因。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: People are dearly more curious about bad news than good.
sentences.zh: 人们对坏消息比对好消息更好奇

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Newspapers and broadcasters are there to provide what the public wants.
sentences.zh: 报纸和广播机构提供公众想要的东西。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: That, however, can lead to significant distortions of perception.
sentences.zh: 然而,这可能导致观念的重大扭曲。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: An example was America’s encounter with EI Nino in 1997 and 1998.
sentences.zh: 1997年和1998年美国与EI Nino的遭遇就是一个例子。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This climatic phenomenon was accused of wrecking tourism, causing allergies, melting the ski-slopes, and causing 22 deaths.
sentences.zh: 这种气候现象被指控破坏旅游业、造成过敏、滑雪机融化和22人死亡。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: However, according to an article in the Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society, the damage it did was estimated at US$4 billion but the benefits amounted to some US$19 billion.
sentences.zh: 然而,根据《美国气象学会公报》的一篇文章,估计其损失为40亿美元,但福利约为190亿美元。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: These came from higher winter temperatures (which saved an estimated 850 lives, reduced heating costs and diminished spring floods caused by meltwaters).
sentences.zh: 这些都是来自冬季气温升高(估计可挽救850人的生命,减少供暖费用,以及融化水引起的春季洪水减少)。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The fourth factor is poor individual perception.
sentences.zh: 第四个因素是个人认识差。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: People worry that the endless rise in the amount of stuff everyone throws away will cause the world to run out of places to dispose of waste.
sentences.zh: 人们担心,人们不断增加的垃圾数量将让世界失去处理垃圾的地方

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Yet, even if America’s trash output continues to rise as it has done in the past, and even if the American population doubles by 2100, all the rubbish America produces through the entire 21st century will still take up only one-12,000th of the area of the entire United States.
sentences.zh: 然而,即使美国垃圾产出继续像过去那样上升,即使美国人口在2100年前翻了一番,美国在整个21世纪中制造的所有垃圾仍将只占美国全国面积的1—12 000分之一。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: So what of global warming?
sentences.zh: 那么全球变暖呢?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: As we know, carbon dioxide emissions are causing the planet to warm.
sentences.zh: 我们知道,二氧化碳排放正在使地球变暖。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The best estimates are that the temperatures will rise by 2-3°C in this century, causing considerable problems, at a total cost of US$5,000 billion.
sentences.zh: 最佳估计是,本世纪气温将上升2-3°C,造成大量问题,总代价为5 000亿美元。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Despite the intuition that something drastic needs to be done about such a costly problem, economic analyses dearly show it will be far more expensive to cut carbon dioxide emissions radically than to pay the costs of adaptation to the increased temperatures.
sentences.zh: 尽管直觉认为,对于这样一个代价高昂的问题,需要做一些重大的事情,但经济分析却严重显示,大幅削减二氧化碳排放量要比支付适应气温升高的费用要昂贵得多。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A model by one of the main authors of the United Nations Climate Change Panel shows how an expected temperature increase of 2.1 degrees in 2100 would only be diminished to an increase of 1.9 degrees.
sentences.zh: 联合国气候变化小组主要作者之一的模型表明,2100年预计温度上升2.1度,但降幅将只有1.9度。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Or to put it another way, the temperature increase that the planet would have experienced in 2094 would be postponed to 2100.
sentences.zh: 或者换句话说,2094年地球的温度升高将推迟到2100年

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: So this does not prevent global warming, but merely buys the world six years.
sentences.zh: 因此,这并不会阻止全球变暖,而只是买下世界六年。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Yet the cost of reducing carbon dioxide emissions, for the United States alone, will be higher than the cost of solving the world’s single, most pressing health problem: providing universal access to clean drinking water and sanitation.
sentences.zh: 然而,单是美国,减少二氧化碳排放的成本将高于解决世界上单一、最紧迫的健康问题的成本:即普及清洁饮用水和卫生设施。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Such measures would avoid 2 million deaths every year, and prevent half a billion people from becoming seriously ill.
sentences.zh: 这些措施将每年避免200万人死亡,防止5亿人重病。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It is crucial that we look at the facts if we want to make the best possible decisions for the future.
sentences.zh: 如果我们想为未来作出尽可能最佳的决定,我们就必须审视事实。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It may be costly to be overly optimistic – but more costly still to be too pessimistic.
sentences.zh: 过于乐观可能代价高昂,但过于悲观的代价却更高。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

items.prompt: Environmentalists take a pessimistic view of the world for a number of reasons.
Data on the Earth’s natural resources has only been collected since 1972.
The number of starving people in the world has increased in recent years.
Extinct species are being replaced by new species.
Some pollution problems have been correctly linked to industrialisation.
It would be best to attempt to slow down economic growth.
